plan.title: Project Setup, Component Architecture & Candidate Profile Schemas
plan.description: Scaffold repository structure, core models for candidate component pool (projects, internships, work experiences, skills, education, certifications), and test framework.

plan.title: Candidate Component Repository Engine & CRUD Store
plan.description: Implement in-memory and file-backed repository for storing, updating, tagging, and querying candidate experience items and technical components.

plan.title: Bullet-Point Action Verb & STAR Impact Metric Normalizer
plan.description: Build bullet-point evaluator following STAR methodology (Situation, Task, Action, Result), detect active verbs, and highlight quantifiable performance metrics.

plan.title: Skills Taxonomy & Technical Hierarchy Engine
plan.description: Classify candidate skills into Languages, Frameworks, Cloud/DevOps, Databases, Tools, and Soft Skills with proficiency and domain weightings.

plan.title: Candidate Profile Import/Export & Multi-Format Ingestion
plan.description: Support ingestion and export of candidate component pools from JSON Resume, Markdown portfolio documents, and structured plain-text files.

plan.title: Job Description (JD) NLP Parser & Requirement Extractor
plan.description: Parse dropped/pasted job descriptions, extract role title, seniority level, must-have requirements, nice-to-have qualifications, and core responsibilities.

plan.title: ATS Keyword Density & Technical Skill Matcher
plan.description: Extract critical ATS keywords, industry acronyms, and technical tooling from job postings to form an optimization target vector.

plan.title: Semantic Relevance & Component Compatibility Scoring Engine
plan.description: Develop multi-variable scoring algorithm to compute compatibility match percentages (0-100%) between candidate projects/internships and JD targets.

plan.title: Intelligent Project & Internship Recommendation Ranker
plan.description: Rank and suggest top candidate projects, internships, and skill badges tailored specifically to maximize interview callback rates for the target JD.

plan.title: ATS Keyword Gap & Missing Skill Detection Engine
plan.description: Identify critical competencies present in the job description that are missing or underrepresented in the candidate's selected components.

plan.title: Interactive Component Checklist & State Management Engine
plan.description: Stateful checklist controller allowing users to interactively check, uncheck, swap, and customize suggested components before finalizing.

plan.title: Resume Page-Budget & Line Density Calculator
plan.description: Estimate physical page layout, line count, bullet constraints, and visual density to ensure a crisp single-page (or two-page) resume standard.

plan.title: Dynamic Section Priority & Layout Configurator
plan.description: Dynamically reorder sections based on target role (e.g. Projects-first for early-career/academic roles vs. Experience-first for senior industry positions).

plan.title: AI Executive Summary & Targeted Objective Generator
plan.description: Synthesize a 3-4 sentence professional summary tightly calibrated to the target company, role, and candidate's ticked highlight components.

plan.title: ATS Compatibility & Parser Compliance Pre-Flight Checker
plan.description: Verify resume headings, fonts, ASCII glyphs, dates, and contact blocks against standard ATS scanner algorithms (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever).

plan.title: Profile Pool vs. Tailored Resume Diff & Delta Inspector
plan.description: Compute side-by-side diff comparing candidate's entire component repository against the customized snapshot created for this specific application.

plan.title: Project & Experience Bullet-Point Rephraser
plan.description: Contextually rephrase component bullet points to incorporate target JD terminology and highlight relevant technologies.

plan.title: Quantifiable Metric & Business Impact Enhancer
plan.description: Analyze accomplishments and prompt for quantifiable metrics (latencies, percentages, revenue, users) to boost impact visibility.

plan.title: Role-Specific Technical Acronym & Nomenclature Harmonizer
plan.description: Align component terminology with JD naming conventions (e.g. 'Kubernetes' vs 'K8s', 'GCP' vs 'Google Cloud Platform').

plan.title: Tailored Cover Letter Synthesis Engine
plan.description: Auto-generate an aligned cover letter connecting the selected resume projects with the hiring team's stated mission and pain points.

plan.title: Interview Prep & Resume Talking-Points Synthesizer
plan.description: Generate probable technical and behavioral interview questions based on the candidate's ticked projects and the JD requirements.

plan.title: ATS-Compliant Markdown & Plaintext Resume Renderer
plan.description: Render customized resume into perfectly formatted, human-readable, and machine-parsable Markdown and clean text outputs.

plan.title: Responsive HTML/CSS Resume Template Engine
plan.description: Provide modern, executive, and technical minimalist HTML/CSS resume templates optimized for web viewing and browser printing.

plan.title: High-Fidelity Print-Ready PDF Styling & Paged Media Controller
plan.description: Implement CSS Paged Media `@page` styling, precise margins, orphan/widow suppression, and print styles for perfect PDF generation.

plan.title: JSON Resume Standard Exporter & Schema Validator
plan.description: Export finalized customized resume into schema-valid `jsonresume.org` standard JSON format for interoperability.

plan.title: Multi-Target Resume Portfolio & Version Snapshot Manager
plan.description: Store and organize tailored resume versions across multiple companies (e.g. Google, Amazon, Microsoft, Stripe) with application status tracking.

plan.title: Interactive Web Dashboard: Component Pool & JD Dropzone
plan.description: Web dashboard interface featuring component input forms (projects, internships, skills) and an intuitive drag-and-drop / paste zone for job descriptions.

plan.title: Interactive Web Dashboard: Recommendation Deck & One-Click Finalizer
plan.description: Interactive suggestion UI with suitability badges, toggle checkboxes for each component, live preview pane, and 'Finalize Resume' button.

plan.title: End-to-End System Integration & Multi-JD Benchmark Test Suite
plan.description: Comprehensive integration testing simulating 10+ real-world tech job descriptions and evaluating ATS compatibility scores.

plan.title: Production Packaging, Comprehensive User Guide & v1.0.0 Release
plan.description: Finalize CLI executable, comprehensive documentation, user manual, and publish official production v1.0.0 release.
